vg.title: Which jobs can I do with my visa?
vg.intro: Your status of residence (在留資格) decides what work you can do in Japan. Check the type on the front of your residence card, and the work permission on the back.
vg.myanmar_text: Since 2021, Japan's emergency measure lets many Myanmar people stay and work with the status Designated Activities (特定活動). Some designations allow full-time work, others only part-time. Rules and screening have changed over time, so always check your designation paper (指定書) and the Immigration Services Agency's latest notice.
vg.isa_myanmar_link: Immigration Services Agency: measures for Myanmar nationals
vg.ssw_text: Specified Skilled Workers can work only in the field of the test they passed. These are the 16 fields:
vg.ssw_change: Fields and intake limits can change (new fields are planned, and new intake in a field can be paused). Check the Immigration Services Agency before applying.
vg.employer_text: Before hiring, check the applicant's residence card in person: the status, the period of stay, and the work permission on the back. You can check whether a card number is valid on the Immigration Services Agency website. Hiring someone outside their permitted work is illegal for the employer too.
vg.disclaimer: This guide is general information, not legal advice. For your own case, ask the Immigration Services Agency, FRESC, or an administrative scrivener (行政書士).
visa.unrestricted: Permanent resident, spouse or long-term resident (no work limits)
visa.dependent: Dependent (家族滞在) with work permission
visa.designated: Designated Activities (特定活動), if work is allowed
visa.skilled: Skilled Labor (技能), e.g. foreign cuisine chef
visa.unrestricted_jp: 永住者・日本人の配偶者等・永住者の配偶者等・定住者
visa.student_jp: 留学 + 資格外活動許可
visa.dependent_jp: 家族滞在 + 資格外活動許可
visa.designated_jp: 特定活動（指定書で確認）
visa.engineer_jp: 技術・人文知識・国際業務
visa.intern_jp: 技能実習（育成就労へ移行予定）
visa.no_work_jp: 短期滞在・文化活動・研修
visa.unrestricted_rule: Any legal job, full-time or part-time, with no limit on hours or type of work.
visa.student_rule: Only with permission to work (資格外活動許可) shown on your residence card. Generally up to 28 hours a week, and up to 8 hours a day during long school holidays. No work in adult entertainment.
visa.dependent_rule: Only with permission to work (資格外活動許可). Generally up to 28 hours a week. No work in adult entertainment.
visa.designated_rule: Depends on the designation paper (指定書) attached to your passport. Some allow full-time work, some up to 28 hours a week, some no work. Many Myanmar nationals hold this status under the emergency measure.
visa.engineer_rule: Professional work that matches your studies or experience: office work, IT, engineering, sales, interpreting, language teaching. Not simple manual work such as factory lines or restaurant floor service.
visa.ssw1_rule: Work only in the field of the skills test you passed, such as food service, care or construction. Changing field needs that field's test. Up to 5 years in total; family can't join you.
visa.ssw2_rule: Skilled work in your field with no total time limit, and your family can join you.
visa.skilled_rule: Work using a special skill, for example a chef of foreign cuisine with long experience. Only that type of work.
visa.nursing_rule: Care work as a certified care worker (介護福祉士).
visa.highly_skilled_rule: Professional work under the points system, with fewer restrictions than other work visas.
visa.intern_rule: You can work only at your training company, so you can't apply for jobs on this site. This system is being replaced by Employment for Skill Development (育成就労) from 2027.
visa.no_work_rule: Temporary Visitor (短期滞在), Cultural Activities and Trainee statuses don't allow paid work.
